title: The technique cards are here
summary: Twelve techniques, two minutes each — the first Relazation deck is out now.
body_html:
Twelve techniques, two minutes each — the first Relazation deck is out now.

Six for right now, six for every day, on heavy matte cards. The front tells you what to do. The back tells you why it works, and which century it came from.
